==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by Endfield Industries Engineering Division.

The biggest feature of this AIC gear is that it allows gears to be flexibly worn inside suits.<ref>[[AIC Light Plate]]</ref>, but comments are made criticizing its weak defense against external forces, with some mentioning that they cannot trust it because "it feels too light."<ref>[[AIC Ceramic Plate]]</ref>
